krismm_queue_desc: Queue tracks to play on the next assault wave.
shuffle_play_no_repeat_desc: Prevents tracks from playing again until all allowed tracks have been played.
shuffle_play_language_desc: Select the language for the mod menus (Requires restart).
shuffle_play_frequency_desc: Change the track every X assault waves.
shuffle_play_menu_tracks_base_desc: Select tracks from the base game.
shuffle_play_track_desc: Enable if you want this song to be in the shuffle playlist.
krismm_queue_track_desc: Click to add this song to the queue.
shuffle_play_enable_all_desc: Enable all tracks in this list.
shuffle_play_disable_all_desc: Disable all tracks in this list.
krismm_open_queue_menu_desc: Open the song queue menu directly.
krismm_toggle_shuffle_desc: Turn the Shuffle Play mod ON or OFF.
